---
title: "Part 1 — The Craft"
---

Part 1 establishes the architectural principle and the craft of turning a real
system into a story: understand the model first, transform it deliberately.

It follows a **reverse-engineering** approach. You will begin by *hearing* the
finished Crossplane restaurant story, then progressively reveal how it was
constructed — from technical model, to metaphor, to characters.

## Lessons

- [1. Engineering Through Stories](01-engineering-through-stories/index.qmd) —
  what technical storytelling is, its benefits and risks, and your first
  listening of the Crossplane restaurant.
- [2. Find the Technical Truth](02-find-the-technical-truth/index.qmd) — model
  the system first, before any metaphor. Produce `concept.md`.
- [3. Design the Metaphor](03-design-the-metaphor/index.qmd) — translate the
  model into a familiar world with an explicit mapping. Produce `metaphor.md`.
- [4. Cast the System](04-cast-the-system/index.qmd) — turn responsibilities
  into characters with voice and relationship. Produce `characters.md`.

Each lesson in this course follows the same page layout — see the
[course overview](../index.qmd) for the full pattern.
